core_philosophy.key_instruction: Eliminate the 'too much red' feedback. Replace red with Deep Indigo/Slate as the primary action color. Red is strictly reserved for destructive actions or critical failures. High perceived effort achieved through dense bento grids, micro-interactions, and glassmorphic floating headers.

rules: Use gap-4 or gap-6 for high-density dashboard layouts.
Containers with borders must use p-6 internally to prevent collision.
Employ 'Bento Box' asymmetry: mix col-span-1, col-span-2, and row-span-2 to create visual tension and hierarchy.
Grid children must stretch using h-full to eliminate jagged bottoms.

surfaces_and_effects.cards: Neumorphism mix: Flat white/slate backgrounds with 1px border-slate-200/800 and soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). On hover, translate-y-[-2px] and shadow-md.
surfaces_and_effects.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-950/80 with border-b border-slate-200/50.
surfaces_and_effects.urgent_timers: Tracing Beam effect: pulsing border using framer-motion or CSS animations for the Restaurant App active order cards.

restaurant_cards.layout: Grid-based cards containing core KPIs (active orders, revenue).
restaurant_cards.visuals: Use subtle glass effects for badges. Left-align data.

analytics_charts.styling: Remove axis grid lines for a cleaner look. Use Area charts with gradient fills (Indigo to transparent). Custom tooltips with backdrop-blur.

program_slots.layout: Horizontal scrollable timeline or Shadcn Calendar.
program_slots.interaction: Click and drag to select slots. Use indigo-100 for available, indigo-600 for selected.

admin_orders_table.visuals: Monospace fonts for Order IDs. Use traffic-light color logic for status badges (Green=Delivered, Amber=Cooking, Blue=Dispatching).

restaurant_app_timer.visuals: Massive IBM Plex Mono typography. Circular pulsing progress ring.
restaurant_app_timer.animation: Pulse animation (animate-pulse) when time is < 5 minutes.

icons.library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - Duotone weight for a premium tech feel.

image_urls.description: Abstract topographic map of a city, dark sleek logistics theme, deep blue and slate colors, glowing routing nodes
Modern sleek restaurant kitchen dashboard screen, close up on a glowing order timer

testing_requirements.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based (e.g., 'admin-orders-table', 'restaurant-timer-display').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Remove the overwhelming red from the previous iteration. Use Indigo/Blue as primary.
Implement the 'Control Room Grid' for the Admin Orders and Analytics. It must look dense, professional, and high-effort.
Use Phosphor icons. Install via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react.
For the Restaurant App timer, implement a highly visible, pulsing component using IBM Plex Mono.
Use the provided image URLs for placeholders, avatars, and authentication backgrounds to establish the high-end logistics mood.
